Did you know you can hold your order up to 90 days with William Wood?

Simply tick "Hold my order in stock for up to 90 days" in checkout and select your chosen date in which you would like your order to be held until.

Or alternatively email hello@williamwoodmirrors.co.uk after placing your order with your order number and the date you would like to hold your order until and an advisor will be happy to accommodate your request.
